roadmap.title: Prologue and Kephallonia
roadmap.description: Complete the opening on Kephallonia and the Battle of 300.

roadmap.title: Episode 2: Megaris and the open sea
roadmap.description: Complete Episode 2, acquire the Adrestia and start early gear and ship work.

roadmap.title: Episode 3: Phokis and the Cult of Kosmos
roadmap.description: Complete Episode 3 and begin Cult, conquest and equipment progression.

roadmap.title: Episode 4: Athens and Perikles
roadmap.description: Complete Episode 4 and learn about your mother.

roadmap.title: Episode 5: Korinth and the Monger
roadmap.description: Complete Episode 5 and learn where your mother sailed.

roadmap.title: Episode 7: Naxos, Atlantis and the family
roadmap.description: Complete Episode 7 and follow the Atlantis and family storylines.

roadmap.title: Episode 7 side questlines
roadmap.description: Finish the major regional and profession questlines tied to achievements.

roadmap.title: World bosses and mythical creatures
roadmap.description: Defeat the mythical bosses and creatures across the Aegean.

roadmap.title: Cult of Kosmos and endgame goals
roadmap.description: Finish the Cult, reach level 50 and clear the remaining combat goals.

roadmap.title: Legendary equipment and naval mastery
roadmap.description: Complete legendary sets and raise the Adrestia to legendary status.

roadmap.title: Exploration and contracts
roadmap.description: Clear underwater locations, unveil the map and finish message-board goals.

roadmap.title: Lost Tales of Greece
roadmap.description: Complete the free Lost Tales of Greece questlines.

roadmap.title: Legacy of the First Blade
roadmap.description: Complete all three Legacy of the First Blade episodes.

roadmap.title: The Fate of Atlantis
roadmap.description: Complete The Heir of Memories and all three Fate of Atlantis episodes.

achievements.summary: Complete the Battle of 300 in the prologue.

steps.text: Fight through the Battle of 300 at the start of a new game.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 1.

steps.text: Follow the Episode 1 story until you leave Kephallonia on the @item{Adrestia}.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 2.

steps.text: Follow the Episode 2 story through the conquest battle at Megara.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 3.

steps.text: Play the Episode 3 story to the Cult of Kosmos meeting that reveals Deimos.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 4.

steps.text: Play the Episode 4 story through Perikles' symposium in Athens.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 5.

steps.text: Play the Episode 5 story and defeat the Monger in Korinthia.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 6.

steps.text: Play the Episode 6 story through the fall of Athens.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 7.

steps.text: Play the Episode 7 story and fight Deimos on the battlefield.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 8.

steps.text: Play the Episode 8 story and defeat Kleon.

achievements.summary: Complete Episode 9 and the epilogue.

steps.text: Finish the Episode 9 story through the final confrontation with Deimos.
Return home afterward and enter the house to play the epilogue.

achievements.summary: Complete every objective at all 42 underwater locations.

steps.text: Dive at all 42 underwater sites, marked by a whale-tail icon, and loot every item each one lists.
Scout each site with @mechanic{Ikaros} before diving to spot the remaining chests and tablets.

achievements.summary: Engrave your first item.

steps.text: At any blacksmith, engrave a weapon or armor piece with any available effect.

achievements.description: Recruit and assign a Legendary NPC for your ship.
achievements.summary: Recruit and assign one legendary NPC as a ship lieutenant.

guide.context: Evie Frye is a free alternative through Ubisoft Club if you do not want to knock out a fort commander.

steps.text: Scan fort captains and polemarchs with @mechanic{Ikaros} and look for a legendary NPC shown in yellow.
Knock the NPC out with bare fists or a @mechanic{Sparta Kick} finishing blow, then recruit them while no enemies are fighting you.
Open the ship menu and assign the recruit to a lieutenant slot.

achievements.description: Acquire and equip your first Legendary item.
achievements.summary: Obtain and equip a legendary weapon or armor piece.

steps.text: Equip any legendary weapon or armor piece; legendary gear is shown in gold.
If you own any story DLC, its starting gear already includes legendary items.

achievements.description: Equip 1 Legendary melee weapon and 5 Legendary armor pieces.
achievements.summary: Equip one legendary melee weapon and five legendary armor pieces.

guide.context: Cultists each drop one legendary piece, and legendary gear cannot be sold or dismantled, so nothing is lost while you collect.

steps.text: Collect legendary gear from Cultists and quest rewards.
Equip a legendary melee weapon plus a legendary piece in every armor slot: head, arms, torso, waist and feet.

achievements.summary: Become Champion of the Arena.

guide.context: The final champion is level 50, so treat the last bouts as endgame content. Mercenary fights do not count toward the championship.

steps.text: Reach the Arena on @loc{Pephka} (Pirate's Point, by boat); its invitation quest appears after you defeat mercenaries in the region.
Defeat all five champions: Klaudios, Belos, Evanthe, Titos and Vasilis.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50.

guide.context: The story alone ends around level 37-40. For the last levels, repeatable level 50 Arena matches award about 70,000 XP each.

steps.text: Reach level 50 by completing quests, message-board contracts, conquest battles and locations.

achievements.summary: Acquire a tier 3 active ability.

guide.context: Passive abilities do not count; only abilities you bind to a slot qualify.

steps.text: Earn artifact fragments from 20 Cultists to upgrade @item{Leonidas' Spear} to tier 5.
Take the fragments to the @loc{Ancient Forge} on Andros and raise the spear to tier 5.
Spend ability points on an active skill and raise it to tier 3.

achievements.summary: Upgrade Leonidas' Spear to tier 6.

guide.context: The upgrade becomes possible once you defeat Kleon in Episode 8, when only Deimos and the Ghost of Kosmos remain off-limits.

steps.text: Defeat the Cultists needed for the remaining artifact fragments.
Take the fragments to the @loc{Ancient Forge} on Andros and raise the spear to tier 6.

achievements.summary: Become the first-ranked mercenary.

guide.context: Only mercenaries ranked above you advance your position, and each kill moves you up a single rank.

steps.text: Raise your bounty and kill higher-ranked mercenaries, one rank at a time.
Track targets from the Mercenaries menu and defeat the top-ranked mercenary to take first place.

achievements.description: Defeat all the Cultists of Kosmos.
achievements.summary: Defeat all 42 Cultists of Kosmos.

guide.context: Sparing Deimos and Aspasia still counts as defeating them. Several members only appear once the main story is finished, so expect a cleanup pass.

steps.text: Follow the Cultist clues and side quests to unmask every member.
Finish the main story first if clues are missing, then hunt the remaining Cultists and their leaders.

achievements.description: Recover the Cyclops's eye from a goat on Kephallonia.
achievements.summary: Find the Cyclops's glass eye by looting goats on Kephallonia.

guide.context: The drop is random and can come from any goat spot on the island.

steps.text: Return to @loc{Kephallonia} after the events of Sequence 1.
Kill and loot goats until the glass eye drops, usually after 10-20 kills.

achievements.summary: Unveil every sub-region in Greece.

guide.context: Some areas stay permanently fogged, such as central Lesbos, the volcanic islands and the Foundry of Hephaistos. Tracking can lag, so the achievement may unlock late.

steps.text: Travel through every land sub-region and across the open sea until the fog clears.
Step on every small island, including ones that already look revealed.
Skip question-mark locations; they are not required.

achievements.summary: Defeat Medusa on Lesbos.

guide.context: Medusa is a level 50 fight, so bring level 46+ gear and use the pillars to break her gaze.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Romancing the Stone Garden} near Eresos on @loc{Lesbos} and follow it to the Dread Ruins.
Find the mercenary near the viewpoint in the Ancient Pearl area, defeat him and speak to Bryce again.
Enter the Petrified Temple and defeat Medusa.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Minotaur in the Labyrinth of Lost Souls.

steps.text: Speak to Ardos on @loc{Messara} to start @mechanic{Myths and Minotaurs} (Episode 7 or later).
Complete the quest chain and enter the Labyrinth of Lost Souls.
Defeat the Minotaur at the end of the labyrinth.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Cyclops on the Forgotten Isle.

guide.context: This is a different boss from the one-eyed enemy in Sequence 1.

steps.text: Complete the Kythera questline starting with @mechanic{A God Among Men}.
Sail to the Forgotten Isle and defeat the Cyclops.

achievements.summary: Outwit the Sphinx.

guide.context: Each attempt asks three questions drawn from the twelve; a wrong answer kills you and rolls a new set.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{A Family's Legacy}, then start Lore of the Sphinx at the ruins by Lake Kopais with Gorgias.
Kill the white lion west of Thebes, take back the medallion, then head to the ruins after dark.
Answer with the correct word: spider, memory, moon, death, river, sun, fish, mountain, tree, hummingbird, time or stars.

achievements.description: Upgrade the Adrestia to Legendary Status.
achievements.summary: Raise every Adrestia upgrade to legendary status.

guide.context: Rough costs at Mercenary Tier 4: 6,021 leather, 10,515 iron, 21,296 wood, 75 ancient tablets, 1,244 obsidian glass, 1,954 precious gems and 250,490 drachmae.

steps.text: Reach Mercenary Tier 4 to add a carpenter, halving the resources each upgrade needs.
Raise every ship category to gold (legendary); the final non-legendary tier is not required.
Gather materials by looting everything and dismantling unwanted gear; ancient tablets come from ruins and some blacksmiths.

achievements.description: Fully crew the Adrestia with Legendary Lieutenants.
achievements.summary: Assign four legendary lieutenants to the Adrestia.

steps.text: Raise the Adrestia's hull to level 4 to unlock all four lieutenant slots.
Recruit four legendary NPCs using the method from You Work for Me Now.
Assign all four on the ship's lieutenant screen.

achievements.description: Complete the Daughters of Artemis questline.
achievements.summary: Complete the Daughters of Artemis questline.

guide.context: Animal locations: Kalydonian Boar west of the temple; Hind of Keryneia in Euboea's western swamp; Nemean Lion in the Sinkholes of Herakles; Kretan Bull on Messara; Kallisto the Bear west of the Temple of Poseidon in Argolis; Lykaon Wolf in south-eastern Lakonia; Erymanthian Boar in the Erymanthos Foothills; Krokottas Hyena at the south tip of Kythera.

steps.text: Start the questline from @npc{Daphnae} at the Temple of Artemis in northern Phokis.
Kill the eight legendary animals across Greece and return to Daphnae.
Finish the questline with Daphnae, who has moved to @loc{Chios}.

achievements.summary: Complete Markos's questline.

guide.context: You can also close the line early by refusing to help Markos after the silo scene.

steps.text: Free @npc{Markos} from the fort on @loc{Kos} and carry him home to start A Business Opportunity.
Complete the chain: Old Friends, Old Problems, then Farm in Flames and Protect Markos.

achievements.summary: Complete the Hippokrates questline.

guide.context: The quest marker sometimes only appears within 20-50 m; clearing other side quests in Boeotia can make it spawn.

steps.text: Start Hunting Party in @loc{Boeotia} and rescue the wounded hunter near Snake Head Rock.
Free the slaves at the marked camp, then finish Inheritance Insurance and Too Much of a Good Thing in southern Thebes.
Mix the patient's dose; either the correct amount or the lethal dose completes the questline.

achievements.summary: Complete Xenia's questline.

guide.context: If Birds of a Feather does not appear, finish the other Keos side quests first.

steps.text: Pay @npc{Xenia} 15,000 drachmae during Island of Misfortune on @loc{Keos} (Sequence 7).
Complete Red in the Wreckage and Lost and Found, then the treasure hunts: Birds of a Feather, then Sacred Vows, then She Who Controls the Seas, then Throw the Dice and finally Priceless Treasure.
Deliver the final relic to Xenia.

achievements.summary: Complete the Olympic questline.

steps.text: The questline starts automatically in Episode 7 after Kings of Sparta.
Complete Delivering a Champion, then The Contender, then The Long Game and Pankration, including the antidote errand for Alkibiades.
Win the final Pankration fight.

achievements.summary: Sink an epic ship.

steps.text: Find an epic ship with a golden crown icon at sea, such as Asterion's vessel west of Andros.
Damage the ship until it is disabled, then keep firing to sink it instead of boarding.

achievements.description: Defeat a Mercenary in the Arena.
achievements.summary: Defeat a mercenary in the Arena.

guide.context: The bout is not always listed; leave the Arena and return later if the mercenary option is missing.

steps.text: Enter the Arena on Pephka and choose the lone mercenary bout below the five champions.
Defeat the mercenary in single combat.

achievements.description: Upgrade the Adrestia for the first time.
achievements.summary: Purchase your first upgrade for the Adrestia.

steps.text: Complete Episode 3 and return to the ship to unlock upgrades.
Buy any single upgrade from the ship menu.

achievements.summary: Equip a full legendary armor set.

guide.context: The Artemis set from the Daughters of Artemis questline is another complete set.

steps.text: Collect all five pieces of one legendary set, such as the Snake Set from the Eyes of Kosmos cultists.
Equip every piece: head, arms, torso, waist and feet.

achievements.description: Spend the night with another character.
achievements.summary: Spend the night with another character.

guide.context: Many characters offer the option, so missing one opportunity does not block the achievement.

steps.text: Pick heart-marked dialogue options whenever they appear; early chances include Auxesia's quest Age is Just a Number at Delphi, Alkibiades at Perikles' symposium and Odessa in Megaris after her rescue on Ithaka.
Complete the romance scene that follows.

achievements.description: Defeat a full cluster of Cultists of Kosmos.
achievements.summary: Defeat a complete cluster of Cultists of Kosmos.

guide.context: Clues come from side quests, story progress and clearing regions.

steps.text: Unmask every member of one Cult branch, then defeat them all including the branch leader.

achievements.description: Discover Atlantis and speak with Pythagoras.
achievements.summary: Discover Atlantis and speak with Pythagoras.

steps.text: Complete A Family's Legacy, which starts after Episode 7's United Front.
On @loc{Thera}, align the mirrors to light the door, enter and speak with @npc{Pythagoras}.

achievements.summary: Cleave a ship in half with a ram.

steps.text: Disable an enemy ship with damage but do not board it.
Ram its center at full speed, holding the speed-up input, to break it in two.

achievements.description: Perform an Overpower Attack with every weapon type.
achievements.summary: Use an Overpower Attack once with each weapon class.

guide.context: Each use consumes three adrenaline segments; the unarmed takedown is not required.

steps.text: Learn Overpower Attacks and Overpower Bow Strike.
Use an overpower attack once with a sword, a dagger, a heavy blunt weapon, a heavy bladed weapon, a staff, a spear and a bow.

achievements.description: Kill the Leader of any Region with Low Resources, other than Megaris.
achievements.summary: Kill a region leader while the region has low resources.

guide.context: Kos is a small, quick region for this.

steps.text: Weaken a region outside Megaris to Vulnerable by killing soldiers, burning war supplies and looting nation treasure.
Kill the region leader while the region is still vulnerable.

achievements.description: Complete 20 Bounties, War Contracts, or Naval Quests from Message Boards.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 message-board quests.

guide.context: Duplicate contracts stack and progress in parallel.

steps.text: Accept every bounty, war contract and naval quest from message boards as you travel.
Complete 20 of them; most finish automatically during normal play.

achievements.description: Complete 20 Quests on Pephka, Obsidian and Abantis islands.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 quests on the Pephka, Obsidian and Abantis islands.

guide.context: Finishing the Hydrea quests before the Melos ones avoids losing part of the pool.

steps.text: Complete 20 side quests across Pephka, the Obsidian Islands (Hydrea, Melos) and the Abantis Islands (Euboea, Skyros).
Count the Pephka arena championship; message-board contracts do not count.

achievements.description: Raise your Bounty to the maximum level.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum bounty level.

guide.context: Killing mercenaries does not raise your bounty.

steps.text: Attack civilians and soldiers in a large town such as @loc{Athens} until the bounty bar shows five helmets.
Stay in combat and do not pay off the bounty.

achievements.description: Win your first on land conquest battle in any region (excluding Megaris in Hero's Journey).
achievements.summary: Win a land conquest battle outside Megaris.

steps.text: Lower a region's power to Vulnerable so the conquest flags appear on the map.
Pick a side at the blue or red flag and win the battle.

achievements.description: Cleave a ship while having an all-women crew.
achievements.summary: Cleave a ship in half while an all-female crew is equipped.

guide.context: The female crew cosmetic is the requirement; female lieutenants are optional.

steps.text: Equip an all-female crew cosmetic, such as Assassins (Female) from Ubisoft Club or Bandits (Female) from the underwater site Sunken Wreck of Datis off @loc{Delos}.
Disable an enemy ship, then ram it at full speed to split it in two.

achievements.description: Engrave a Legendary Item with a Legendary Effect.
achievements.summary: Apply a legendary engraving to a legendary weapon or armor piece.

steps.text: Collect two legendary items, because an engraving cannot be applied to the item that teaches it.
At a blacksmith, choose Engrave and apply a yellow (legendary) engraving to the other item.

achievements.description: Complete The Show Must Go On.
achievements.summary: Finish The Show Must Go On questline in Elis.

steps.text: Start at the theater in @loc{Elis} and begin A Sophisticated Tibble.
Collect the special wine at Fort Demiurgi, follow the lead to the cave for the real wine and deliver it.
Bring the three missing actors back, then perform the play in Showtime.

achievements.summary: Defeat Steropes the Lightning Bringer on Andros.

steps.text: Find @enemy{Steropes} in the Bay of Nobody, east of the Ancient Forge on @loc{Andros}.
Dodge his ranged attacks, shoot the glowing eye to stun him, then close in for melee damage.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales questline Divine Intervention.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Test of Judgement} in @loc{Korinth} after completing Episode 4 and starting Episode 5.
Complete the series of quests given by the mysterious woman.

achievements.summary: Defeat Arges the Bright One on Nisyros.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Nisyros} in the volcanic islands and find @enemy{Arges} in the crater area.
Aim for his glowing eye to interrupt attacks, then finish him; he drops his hammer.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales questline The Image of Faith.

steps.text: Start The Measure of a Man in @loc{Elis}, west of the Forgotten Swamps, and recover Polykleitos's stolen tools at Quicksand Bay.
Help the villagers: burn the cursed silo for Bad Weeds, track the totem to a wolf den for Down From On High, and kill seven deer for The Wild Hunt.
Clear the chickens at the eastern farm, then bring the antidote from the southern cave back for A Matter of Faith.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales questline The Daughters of Lalaia.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{A Storm Gathering} in @loc{Phokis} after completing Episode 4 and starting Episode 5.
Complete the chain and save the village.

achievements.summary: Kill the Makedonian Lion at Mount Athos.

steps.text: Travel to the Mount Athos synchronization point at the top of the mountain.
Kill the elite lion nearby.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies using the Death Veil ability
achievements.summary: Land 10 assassination kills that trigger Death Veil.

steps.text: Unlock the @mechanic{Death Veil} passive in the Assassin skill tree; it hides bodies after stealth kills.
Assassinate enemies in one hit until 10 kills trigger the effect; boost assassination damage or add engravings if kills are not clean.

achievements.description: Discover the truth about Darius's past.
achievements.summary: Finish the Episode 1 story of Legacy of the First Blade.

guide.context: The Legacy of the First Blade episodes become available after Episode 7 and the Birthright questline.

steps.text: Play the Makedonia storyline and defeat the Huntsman, Pactyas.
Return to the Rock Arch hideout and speak to Natakas and Darius one last time.

achievements.description: Land a Rush Assassinate that chains 4 times with the Blade of the Lion
achievements.summary: Chain four Rush Assassinate hits using the Pride of the Lion.

guide.context: Rush Assassinate caps at three targets on its own; the Episode 1 reward sword adds the fourth chain.

steps.text: Max Rush Assassinate to 3/3 and equip the @item{Pride of the Lion}, awarded during Episode 1's Shadow of a Legend.
Find four enemies close together, start the chain and hit all four in a row; the targets do not need to die.

achievements.description: Kill all the Ancients in the Order of the Hunters in Makedonia
achievements.summary: Kill all seven Order of the Hunters members in Makedonia.

steps.text: Start the Order's hunt after Birthright and follow the episode's story to unlock the roster.

Find each member with their clue: Phratagoune (Darius's desk), Konon (after Phratagoune), Akantha (Olynthos Fort), Echion (Dead Man Rises), Timosa (Mysterious Malady) and Bubares (Olynthos letters, then the goat farm meeting).
Defeat all seven, ending with Pactyas through Whimpers Through the Fog.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales quest A Poet's Legacy.

steps.text: Start just east of the docks of Mount Helikon.
Collect roses from the nearby mountain, recover and repair the lyre, and deal with the rowdy drunks.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales questline A Brother's Seduction.

steps.text: With Chapter 5 started, clear the guards at the Altar of the Cyclops in the Isthmus of Poseidon and carry Lykinos home.
Work through the chain: Bloody Libation at the Ruined Temple of Zeus, the armor errand at the merchant north of Mycenae, and Honoring the Dead at the Port of Kechries cemetery.
Finish with the deer hunt, the spar with Timotheos on Salamis and the rescue near Mycenae.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies using the Rapid Fire ability.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies with the Rapid Fire ability.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Rapid Fire} in the Hunter tree.
Weaken enemies first, then land the killing blow with Rapid Fire on 10 enemies.

achievements.summary: Set 10 enemy ships on fire.

guide.context: The Chimera's Breath flamethrower is installed during Episode 2 by collecting four code books in Patrai: two in the shipyard and two on ships north of the docks.

steps.text: Fill the flame emblem over an enemy ship until its outline turns white, using fire arrows, fire javelins or the Chimera's Breath.
Repeat on 10 enemy ships; small ships need one volley, and merchant ships do not count.

achievements.description: Heal by parrying 10 times with the Judgment of the Lion.
achievements.summary: Parry 10 times while wielding the Judgment of the Lion.

steps.text: Get the @item{Judgment of the Lion} axe by defeating the Tempest during the Order of the Storm missions.
Equip it and parry 10 attacks; parrying at full health still counts.

achievements.summary: Finish the Episode 2 story of Legacy of the First Blade.

steps.text: Play the Episode 2 story through the sea battle with the Tempest.
Continue the story through the family reunion and the short market trip.

achievements.description: Kill all of the Ancients in the Order of the Storm in Achaia.
achievements.summary: Kill all five Order of the Storm members in Achaia.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Into the Storm} and collect the three clues: Olouros Fort, the leader's house in north-eastern Achaia and the House of the Phoenician.

Find the members: Sophos (manifest in Shipwreck Cove), Nester (Olouros Fort letter, then sink his ship), Augos (beach south of Shipwreck Cove), Megakreon (Theatrics and Espionage in Patrai) and Phila (story).
Defeat all five.

achievements.description: Complete A Friend Worth Dying For
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales questline A Friend Worth Dying For.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Barnabas} on @loc{Skiros} to start the search for Leda.
Complete the four quests: the Kos tomb for the siren's instrument, the Anaphi cave and Polyphemos, the bracelet on Paros and the suitors in Attika's Parnes Mountains.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales quest The Heir of Memories.

guide.context: This prologue opens The Fate of Atlantis expansion story.

steps.text: After Chapter 5, speak to Aletheia at the Temple of Poseidon on the islet between Chios and Samos, then find Theras on Seriphos.
Collect the three symbols: Tomb of Agamemnon in Argolis, Tomb of Eteokles in Attika's Sacred Plains of Demeter, and Oropos Heights in Boeotia.
Recite the symbols in order: Itira, Korgath, Metin.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies using the Fury of the Bloodline Ability.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies with Fury of the Bloodline.

guide.context: People and aggressive animals count; passive animals do not.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Fury of the Bloodline} in the Warrior tree.
Weaken enemies first because the ability hits softly and has a long cooldown, then finish 10 with it.

achievements.summary: Finish the Episode 3 story of Legacy of the First Blade.

steps.text: Play the Episode 3 story through the battle with Amorges.
Continue the story through the reunion scene and the short marked trip.

achievements.description: Heal by getting 10 headshot kills while you have the Golden Harbinger equipped.
achievements.summary: Get 10 headshot kills while the Golden Harbinger is equipped.

steps.text: Get the @item{Golden Harbinger} staff by defeating Gergis the Herald.
Equip it and land 10 headshot kills; animals and civilians count and healing is not required.

achievements.summary: Acquire the Sword of Kings.

steps.text: Take the broken sword you receive after defeating Amorges to the blacksmith in Kirrha, Phokis.
Complete @mechanic{Remnant of the Ancients}; the supplies are already on hand and the sword is repaired instantly.

achievements.description: Kill all the Ancients in the Order of Dominion in Messenia
achievements.summary: Kill all seven Order of Dominion members in Messenia.

steps.text: Follow the story kills: The Immortals, Dimokrates, Gergis the Herald and Amorges.
Find Pithias from the Pedasos Camp clue, Artazostre from Keadas Cave (or roaming Aipeia at night), and Gaspar from the swamp clue north of the Bay of Hades.
Defeat all seven.

achievements.description: Complete One Really, Really Bad Day
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales quest One Really, Really Bad Day.

steps.text: Start in @loc{Lokris} on the northern shore of the White Crystal Hills and defend the village from the pirate invasion.
Help the blacksmith, recover the stolen horse for the breeder and bring Ajax back from the southern camp.
Defeat the impostor and his Chikaros.

achievements.description: Complete Every Story Has an Ending
achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales quest Every Story Has an Ending.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Herodotos} on the ship and take him to Samos; complete the side quests there.
If it has not unlocked, speak with Sokrates in Attika, then return to the ship and take Herodotos to the final marked destination.

achievements.summary: Kill the three Overseers in Elysium.

guide.context: Persephone does not need to be defeated for this.

steps.text: Defeat Iphigenia at Iphigenia's Compound in Pheraia's Retreat.
Defeat Aegea at the Fortress of Three Sisters in Deukalion's Heritage.
Defeat Atalanta at the Mausoleum of the Kingless Queen in Minos's Faith.

achievements.displayName: In the Face of the Gods
achievements.summary: Finish the Episode 1 story of The Fate of Atlantis.

steps.text: While working through Adonis's questline, reach @mechanic{Dead Kings and Pretty Things}.
Recruit your grandfather and win the friendly duel.

achievements.description: Destroy all of the Marble Maiden Tributes.
achievements.summary: Destroy all Marble Maiden Tributes in Elysium.

steps.text: Find and destroy every Marble Maiden statue in Elysium; undiscovered ones appear as question marks and then as statue icons.
Expect a few guards at each statue; every one destroyed also grants an ability point and lowers Persephone's control.

achievements.description: Collect all the Keeper's Insights in Episode 1.
achievements.summary: Collect all four Keeper's Insights in Elysium.

guide.context: Gaia's Underpass hides its insight behind destructible walls; listen for wind to find them.

steps.text: Find the insights in Gaia's Underpass and the Pheraia's Retreat river.
Search the cave north of Persephone's compound in Asphodel Fields.
Climb to the final insight in Minos's Faith; it is tied to The Keeper and Key Maker.

achievements.description: Win the conquest of Elysium with freed humans from the 3 main regions.
achievements.summary: Win the conquest of Elysium after freeing humans in all three regions.

guide.context: Complete the liberation quest before the final act; if you finish Elysium first, return and complete it to still earn the achievement.

steps.text: Complete Free Their Minds, the Rest Will Follow by liberating eight mind-controlled humans in each region: Minos's Faith, Deukalion's Heritage and Pheraia's Retreat.
Finish The Rebellion's Uprising to win the conquest.

achievements.summary: Complete the Lost Tales questline Old Flames Burn Brighter.

steps.text: Start in the eastern Forest of Soron in @loc{Arkadia} and reunite with Anais.
Complete Where We Left Off, Runaway and Unplanned Parenthood.
For A Night in Tegea, search her house and pick the correct meal options: lamb with olives, pears with honey and strong wine.

achievements.summary: Defeat Cerberos in the Underworld.

steps.text: Finish the Elysium finale with Persephone to be thrown into the Underworld.
Fight @enemy{Cerberos} up close to avoid his fireballs and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Close all 18 Tartaros Rifts in the Underworld.

steps.text: Close the first rift during Guardian of the Gates, then find the other 17 across the Scorched Lands, Chasm of Torment and Mourning Fields.
Scout each area with @mechanic{Ikaros} and clear the enemies inside a rift to seal it.
Wear the full Armor of the Fallen set to reach rifts hidden behind Veils.

achievements.summary: Defeat all of the Fallen in the Underworld.

steps.text: Start with the Fallen in Lost but Not Forgotten and follow each clue to the next target.
Hunt them by their white flaming-skull markers, including targets tied to optional side quests.
Equip the complete Armor of the Fallen to pass through Veils and defeat the remaining Fallen.

achievements.description: Collect all the Keeper's Insights in Episode 2.
achievements.summary: Collect all three Keeper's Insights in the Underworld.

steps.text: Find the three insights while exploring the Underworld; they sit near key points rather than in hidden tunnels.

achievements.summary: Defeat Hades in the Underworld.

steps.text: Complete the Underworld storyline and defeat @enemy{Hades}.
Watch the cutscene that follows to finish the episode.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Isu Soldiers with the Blessing of Kronos enhancement.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Isu Soldiers with Blessing of Kronos active.

steps.text: Get the @mechanic{Blessing of Kronos} enhancement from a Keeper's Insight in the Porimos Ring, enhance Venomous Attack and assign it to an active slot.
Activate it and kill 10 Isu Soldiers during its 15 seconds; the Doma of Atlas is a good spot.

achievements.summary: Completely fill the Knowledge Sequence in Atlantis.

steps.text: Raise knowledge by scanning Isu slabs (+3, unmarked), Isu Data Caches (+20) and the three Keeper's Insights (+30).
Keep scanning until the sequence meter is full; you do not need every piece of knowledge in Atlantis.

achievements.summary: Forge the three legendary weapons in Atlantis.

guide.context: Ingots sit in the Oikos of Atlantis, the archives and the Porimos Ring insight areas.

steps.text: Collect nine Adamant Ingots; the Fire Amid the Water side quest starts when you find the first one.
Forge the three legendary weapons at the Forge of Atlantis; each one costs three ingots.

achievements.description: Collect all the Keeper's Insights in Episode 3.
achievements.summary: Collect all three Keeper's Insights in Atlantis.

steps.text: Find the three insights in the Atlantis episode; they are close together.
Check the second floor of the area before leaving to grab an Adamant Ingot as well.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Hekatonchires in Atlantis.

steps.text: Finish the Atlantis questline and speak to Poseidon in the throne room.
Defeat the Hekatonchires to complete the DLC.
